text:
debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r l-o-g-g-e-d the p-l-a-n t-o a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e a-c-c-e-s-s a-t-t-e-m-p-t-s a-g-a-i-n-s-t l-o-y-a-l-t-y a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s in a f-i-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g a-l-l a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r n-o-t-e-d the i-n-t-e-n-t i-o-n to c-o-n-v-e-r-t g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s in-t-o c-a-s-h o-r g-o-o-d-s in a r-e-c-o-r-d-e-d n-a-r-r-a-t-i-v-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g f-r-a-u-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n s-c-o-p-i-n-g.
3) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-s-c-r-i-b-e-d the g-o-a-l to m-a-k-e a-c-t-i-v-i-t-y a-p-p-e-a-r l-i-k-e n-o-r-m-a-l s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g in a c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l m-o-n-i-t-o-r-i-n-g r-u-l-e-s.
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-t-a-i-n-e-d the e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e a-s a f-i-l-e-d e-x-h-i-b-i-t r-e-f-e-r-e-n-c-e in a c-o-n-t-a-i-n-e-d r-e-c-o-r-d while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g s-t-a-k-e-h-o-l-d-e-r n-o-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d the e-x-e-r-c-i-s-e a-s a c-l-o-s-e-d i-c-c m-a-t-t-e-r in a s-e-a-l-e-d f-i-l-e while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g p-o-s-t-i-n-g r-e-v-i-e-w s-i-g-n-o-f-f.
